analyst.summary: Newgen Software provides low-code and business-process-management software, mainly to large BFSI clients in India and select overseas markets. Growth has slowed noticeably over the past year after a stronger multi-year run, and the timing of large license deals makes quarterly results lumpy. The company remains solidly profitable with a clean balance sheet, but rising customer receivables and the growth slowdown are worth watching before expecting a return to its earlier pace.
